label.purpose: Button text, input text, form elements.

code.purpose: Inline code, numeric readouts during drag.

shadows.name: glow-accent
shadows.purpose: Per-synth accent glow. Permitted in synth theme.css files only.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Primary action. Used for Reset, Share, and navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { background: #242424; color: #e0e0e0; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: #e0e0e0; color: #e0e0e0; } .ds-btn-default:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-default:disabled { cursor: default; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0e0e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Text, search, and textarea fields. Full-width, clean borders.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1a1a1a; color: #e0e0e0; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; width: 100%; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #666666; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0e0e0; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Knob
components.description: Circular drag control. Rotates -135deg to +135deg mapped to 0–1. Cursor hidden during drag.
components.css: .ds-knob { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #2e2e2e; background: #1a1a1a; position: relative; cursor: grab; } .ds-knob-indicator { position: absolute; bottom: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(0deg); width: 2px; height: 12px; background: #e0e0e0; transform-origin: bottom center; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Vertical toggle switch. Clicks through options, nub animates to position.
components.css: .ds-switch { width: 20px; height: 36px; background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius: 10px; position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-nub { position: absolute; left: 3px; right: 3px; height: 10px; background: #e0e0e0; border-radius: 5px; top: 0%; transition: top 0.12s; }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Hover-revealed description above controls. Hidden by default.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { position: relative; } .ds-tooltip-text { display: none; position: absolute; bottom: 120%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #1a1a1a; color: #e0e0e0; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; z-index: 10; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; } .ds-tooltip:hover .ds-tooltip-text { display: block; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Top navigation bar with synth name and action buttons.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2e2e2e; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-title { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; color: #e0e0e0; margin: 0; } .ds-nav-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a white-walled gallery. The synth panel is the art — it carries color, texture, identity. The app chrome is the frame: minimal, precise, receding. It provides structure without demanding attention. The system is in transition. The current token layer is dark (inkwell blacks, deep graphite surfaces), an artifact of early development. The creative direction calls for a light foundation — white-backed, bright, as clean as Arturia's brand site. This migration is pending; the shape phase will produce the new palette.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome base with per-synth theme injection via [data-theme]
System fonts throughout — platform-native, no display/body pairing
Knobs and switches that feel physical: mouse-drag-driven, direct feedback
URL-encoded presets with no backend — every state is a shareable link

rules.name: The Single Stack Rule
rules.body: Use only the system sans stack. No display font, no secondary family. Per-synth themes may inject a heading font via their theme.css, but the base uses only system-ui.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never use box-shadow for elevation. Color difference and borders are the only depth mechanisms. The glow-accent token is permitted only in per-synth theme.css files for synth-specific identity, never in the base chrome.

dos: Do use the system sans stack (system-ui, sans-serif) for all base chrome text.
Do inject per-synth identity through [data-theme] CSS custom property overrides in src/synths/<name>/theme.css.
Do use borders and background color difference as the sole depth mechanism — never shadows in the base chrome.
Do keep button and input vocabulary consistent across all screens.
Do use the mono stack for numeric values, code, and drag-feedback overlays.
donts: Don't use cyberpunk / neon-on-black in the base app chrome.
Don't introduce a second font family in the base styles.
Don't use box-shadow for elevation on base components.
Don't create corporate SaaS dashboard patterns.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) anywhere.
Don't use glassmorphism or backdrop-filter blur for decorative effect.
Don't add decorative motion that doesn't convey a state change.
